footnotes: Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 2.3× to $40.7M in 2025. Gross margin was 3.1%, versus 20.6% a year earlier, and the operating loss widened to $66.6M from $19.3M.
The net loss widened to $72.1M, or −$0.73 per share, from $24.1M. Operating cash flow was −$89.1M and free cash flow −$95.8M, versus −$18.0M.
sources: Red Cat Holdings, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)

revenueLine.say: Product made up 93 percent of revenue.

risks: We have incurred net losses since inception

Our products require a continuing investment in research and development, and may experience technical problems or delays…
The nature of our business involves significant risks and uncertainties that may not be covered by insurance or indemnity
Product quality issues and a higher-than-expected number of warranty claims or returns could harm our business and operating results
